coaching_notes: Don't trust gurus. Don't trust me. Test it yourself, on your own data, with your own broker.
Test conditions must be as close to real trading as possible â€” otherwise you're not testing a strategy, you're testing an illusion.
Include all your broker's commissions, real spread, and enable random delay and slippage emulation.
Avoid overfitting â€” don't keep changing parameters until the past looks perfect; that discovers the shape of historical data, not an edge.
Avoid look-ahead bias â€” don't use information that didn't exist at the moment of the trade.
One lucky month is not a strategy â€” it's a coincidence dressed up as a system; period selection can fake beautiful results.
A beautiful equity curve is not proof.
Working combinations exist but finding them requires an honest test; the base/default version doesn't work as promised.
element_inventory: PRECONDITION: US market open at 09:30 New York time defines the session start
Opening Range = high and low (plus midpoint) of the first 5-minute candle, 09:30-09:35
Breakout trigger: candle body closes completely outside the range (full close, not a wick or touch)
Retest confirmation: candle opens outside the range, wick dips inside, and close is back outside the range
Invalidation/selection rule: a candle that closes inside the range voids the signal â€” wait for the next candle
Entry: open of the next candle after the valid retest
Stop loss placed at the range midpoint
Take profit at 2:1 (TP to SL) ratio
Risk per trade: 1% of deposit (configurable â€” percentage of deposit or fixed lot)
Timeframe / market-open time / breakout / retest / TP:SL ratio are configurable advisor parameters
Decisions made on closed candles only (look-ahead eliminated)
strategies.entry_summary: On the US session open (09:30 NY), the first 5-minute candle (09:30-09:35) forms the Opening Range (high, low, and midpoint). Wait for a valid breakout: a candle whose body closes completely outside the range (a full close, not a wick or touch). After the breakout, wait for a valid retest: a candle that opens outside the range, wicks back inside, and closes back outside; if a candle closes inside the range the signal is invalid and you wait for the next one. Enter on the open of the next candle after the valid retest.
strategies.exit_summary: Stop loss at the range midpoint; take profit at a 2:1 (take-profit to stop-loss) ratio. All decisions made on closed candles only.
